name: Lotosaurus
sum: Lotosaurus is a heavily built, sail-backed poposauroid from the Middle Triassic of Hunan Province, China.
holotype: IVPP V 4881 (possibly V 4880), an articulated, well-preserved skeleton.
material: The holotype, a referred skull (IVPP V 48013) and many articulated and disarticulated remains from a bonebed made almost entirely of Lotosaurus.
biology: A heavily built quadruped with a back sail; the bonebed suggests many individuals died together (Hagen et al. 2018 discuss its taphonomy).
author: Zhang 1975
